journey.name: Recap — the December banner, the five pages, and where each share target lands
journey.description:
The yearly recap (Architecture.md §8.8) is offered on Home from 16 to 31 December UTC and is built from what the account already holds. Nothing here can be reached by waiting for December, so the date is moved instead: a DEBUG build reads a `recap_now` long extra (epoch millis) on launch. Do not set the device clock — the homeserver refuses the session.
Needs a signed-in session (journey 01 or 20) with at least one card studied this year. 20 December 2026 is 1797724800000.
Android: `adb shell am force-stop com.github.jvsena42.loopky` then `adb shell am start -n com.github.jvsena42.loopky/.MainActivity --el recap_now 1797724800000`. iOS: launch with `-recapNow 1797724800000`.
The share legs differ by platform and by what is installed. On an emulator none of X, Threads, WhatsApp or Instagram exists, so what is checked there is the fallback, not the app.

actions.action: Launch normally, with no extra, and verify Home shows NO element with resource-id "recap_banner"
Relaunch with recap_now set to 20 December and verify "recap_banner" is present above the daily-goal hero and reads "Your 2026 Recap is ready"
Tap "recap_banner" and verify the first page reads "Your 2026 Recap" with "recap_next" and "recap_close" present
Tap "recap_next" and verify the page states the cards studied, and the cards mastered beneath it only when that is above zero
Tap "recap_next" and verify the decks studied, "Most studied: ", and the decks created line only when one was created this year
Tap "recap_next" and verify a persona title, its one-line reason, and the Languages and Topics pills — topics must NOT contain "language" or a language's own name

Tap "recap_next" and verify "recap_card" shows the share picture, "recap_next" is gone, confetti falls across the WHOLE screen (not a speck in the top-left corner), and the six targets "recap_share_pubky", "_x", "_threads", "_instagram", "_whatsapp" and "_more" are present, each with its network's mark
Tap "recap_share_pubky" and verify a dialog whose "recap_post_preview" ends with a https://loopky.app/recap/?pubky=…&year=2026 link. Tap "recap_post_dismiss" and verify nothing was posted
Tap "recap_share_pubky" again, then "recap_post_confirm", and verify a "Posted" toast and the post on the account's pubky.app feed
Tap "recap_share_more" and verify the system share sheet opens with a square image and a caption ending in the recap link

Tap "recap_share_x", "recap_share_threads" and "recap_share_whatsapp" in turn. With the app installed, verify it opens with the image and caption; without it, verify the browser opens that network's composer with the caption (no image — a URL cannot carry one)

Tap "recap_share_instagram". With Instagram installed verify Instagram's own picker opens (Story, Feed, Reels) holding the 1080x1920 picture, and that in Story the tagline and "loopky.app" are on two separate lines, not drawn over each other; without it verify the system share sheet opens
Tap "recap_web_link" and verify the browser opens the recap page for this pubky and year

TABLET. At expanded width (landscape tablet, or `wm density 240` and landscape on a phone AVD) verify the banner sits above BOTH panes of Home, and the last recap page puts the picture and the share targets side by side
DARK. With the dark theme, verify every text on the recap pages and on the banner is legible — they sit on the accent and must use the on-accent tokens
Tap "recap_close", then "recap_banner_dismiss", and verify the banner is gone. Relaunch with the same recap_now and verify it stays gone
Relaunch with recap_now set to 20 December of the NEXT year (1829260800000) and verify the banner is back, for that year
ZEROES. On an account with cards studied but none mastered, verify neither the picture nor the Pubky preview says "0 cards mastered"
NO DECKS. On an account with no decks at all, verify Home shows NO "recap_banner" on 20 December
EMPTY. On an account with decks but nothing studied and none created this year, open the recap and verify "recap_empty" reads "Nothing to recap yet" rather than a page of zeroes

A FAILED READ. With the network cut after Home has loaded its decks, open the recap and verify an error with Retry — never "Nothing to recap yet" and never a smaller number. Restore the network, tap Retry, and verify the full year
